abstract: Chegg's Q2 2024 earnings report reveals a significant decline in the company's core business as students shifted to ChatGPT for educational support. The company experienced a 50% subscriber decline from peak levels and responded with a 23% workforce reduction, explicitly identifying AI as the primary competitive threat to its tutoring marketplace business model.
keyFindings: Chegg subscribers declined 50% from peak levels as students shifted to using ChatGPT instead.
The company laid off 23% of its workforce in response to changing market conditions.
Chegg identified AI as the primary competitive threat to its business.
methodology: Quarterly financial results and operational metrics disclosed in official earnings report.
qualifiers: Based on limited excerpt from earnings report; full financial details and comparative analysis not provided in source material.
